payload.title: libvips opens an upload only with the loader the inspector named
payload.context: Images (#25): VIPS_BLOCK_UNTRUSTED alone still lets libvips load TIFF and GIF.
payload.rationale: The upload is opened with jpegload, pngload or webpload by name, never by sniffing. The environment variable is a second lock, and the optional loader packages are not installed.
payload.consequences: A new accepted format needs an explicit loader entry.
